name: QR_Rule_02: New User Account Created or Enabled
description: Detects creation of a new Windows user account (4720) or re-enabling of a disabled account (4722).
gpo_policy: User account management auditing must be enabled.
expression: SELECT username, "TargetUserName", "Event ID" FROM events WHERE "Event ID" IN ('4720','4722') LAST 5 MINUTES
cre_logic: Test: Event ID is any of 4720 or 4722. Response: Dispatch New Event and create an Offense indexed by TargetUserName.
